answer: Grades are slashed when a juror diverges from the panel median. Disagreement dilutes the reward instead of splitting it evenly. Every claim gets a second reader with no stake in the outcome. This does not stop a patient attacker from buying honest looking work. It does mean an oasis of clones needs real reviewers per submission, priced per head. The lagoon looks calm until the panel invoice arrives. The pearl is the cost, not the code.
